name: arith_totient_dvd_self_iff
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : n.totient ∣ n ↔ n = 1 ∨ ∃ a b : ℕ, n = 2 ^ (a + 1) * 3 ^ b
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), n.totient ∣ n ↔ n = 1 ∨ ∃ a b : ℕ, n = 2 ^ (a + 1) * 3 ^ b
informal: φ(n) | n iff n = 1 or n = 2^a 3^b with a ≥ 1 — n/φ(n) = ∏ p/(p-1) must be an integer; for n>2 φ is even so 2 | n; the largest prime factor q>2 forces ∏(p-1) | ∏ p·…, compare 2-adic valuations: each odd prime contributes a factor 2 to φ, so at most one odd prime, and (q-1) | 2^a q forces q = 3.
